fullPassage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of how phenomena are arranged on Earth's surface, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.

questions.passage: Moving up in scale, without some awareness of how phenomena are arranged on Earth's surface, it is difficult to make __________ (reason) business or policy judgments.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: reason(동사/명사) → reasoned(형용사). reasoned judgments = 합리적인 판단.
det.analysis: reasoned: 과거분사가 형용사로 사용 (합리적인, 이치에 맞는). make reasoned judgments = 합리적 판단을 내리다.

questions.passage: Understanding why and where migration happens requires __________ (consider) of the political organization of territory and the spatial consequences of discrimination.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: consider(동사) → consideration(명사). requires consideration = 고려를 필요로 한다.
det.analysis: requires + 명사(목적어). consider(동사) → consideration(명사).
det.tip: consider(고려하다) → consideration(고려, 명사). require consideration = 고려를 필요로 하다

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of ____ — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of how phenomena are arranged on Earth's surface, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가장 단순한 일상 활동도 공간적 상황(spatial circumstances)에 대한 이해를 필요로 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① spatial circumstances
❌ ② historical traditions
❌ ③ economic theories
❌ ④ political ideologies
✅① spatial circumstances: 원문과 일치
❌② historical traditions: 역사적 전통 — 문맥과 다름
❌③ economic theories: 경제 이론 — 문맥과 다름
❌④ political ideologies: 정치 이념 — 문맥과 다름
det.tip: spatial circumstances = 공간적 상황 (위치, 배열 등)

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심 질문은 단순한 "where" 질문이 아니라 "why there"과 "so what" 질문이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① "when" and "how much"
✅ ② "why there" and "so what"
❌ ③ "who" and "how many"
❌ ④ "which" and "what kind"
✅② "why there" and "so what": 원문과 일치
❌① "when" and "how much": 시간/양 — 지리학의 핵심 아님
❌③ "who" and "how many": 인물/수 — 문맥과 다름
❌④ "which" and "what kind": 종류 — 문맥과 다름
det.tip: 지리학의 핵심 질문: where → why there (왜 거기서) + so what (그래서 어쨌는데)
